existingApiScopeChecks.meaning: These are explicit scope counterexamples, not bugs in the existing APIs or full-range IOI2017 production validations.

nowruz.verified: Adding a free cell with exactly one existing marked neighbor preserves induced connected acyclicity; leaf delta checked literally including singleton->2vertices. Exact all-subset tree oracle bounds quality.
nowruz.unconfirmed: Official ten output files were not retrieved/solved. This growth method has no full-score guarantee; no invented optimum or 100-point claim.

wiring.verified: Independent literal all-edge-set minimum equals quadratic prefix DP AND new fully-derived linear monochromatic-block prefix/suffix minima DP. Adjacent-block exclusion and one-overlap split prove recurrence; separated-group edge-cover closed form is attained by stars. Three maximum-size exact closed-form families checked.
wiring.unconfirmed: Production reusable C++20/API/overflow/exception/sanitizer validation has not been performed. The official editorial supplies only the high-level linear DP; explicit recurrence/proof here is an independent supplement.

train.verified: Alternating reachability-attractor deletion equals literal extensive first-visit minimax including permanent switches and repeated vertices. Queue/counter implementation would be O(NM), not implemented as a production API here.

prize.verified: Response sum identifies prize level. Equal-level boundary left-count difference is exact number of strictly better prizes in between; zero remaining count safely prunes for every transcript-consistent fixed completion. Count growth is checked with exact integer recursion.
prize.unconfirmed: No implementation or independent worst-case proof of the official efficient 4759/required5000-query strategy. Fixed-sequence gap tests do not establish adaptive-grader full-score correctness/budget.

simurgh.verified: Independent reference-tree fundamental-cycle differences classify every reference edge in <=1+2(N-1) queries. A forest can be completed with known reference edges; subtract known contribution to get exact forest count. Star counts give hidden degrees; leaf-star subset bisection recovers the hidden tree. EVERY oracle question explicitly DSU-validated as a spanning tree.

books.verified: Full reversible 0-1 state shortest paths equal interval-cycle closure DP and author greedy comparing first cross-boundary cycle reach costs. Probe uses explicit small closures, not a linear-time production implementation.
books.numericBoundsSource: Final contest KOR statement n<=1000000, NOT old Library editorial draft subtask table/API.
